The <b>{{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}}</b> is a crafting station introduced with the Stranger Sins DLC, that may be built in the [[cellar]] after the [[Farming and Nature (Tech Tree)|Zombie-brewery]] technology has been unlocked. Here, a [[zombie]] can work towards producing [[A mug of beer|beer]] from [[water]], [[hops]], and [[wheat]]. This workstation has a pre-designated location in the top-right corner of the cellar, with the [[zombie-winery]] in the opposite corner. Unlike the [[brewing stand]], this workstation cannot make [[A mug of mead|mead]].

'''Note:''' The player can't work at this station on their own, the products must be queued and the zombie then prepares them. It's possible to order several products at once in a task queue.{{clear}}
